answer.answer: In fiscal 2025 (ended June 30, 2025), Microsoft changed how it reports its business segments. Goodwill was reallocated across impacted reporting units using a relative fair value approach [6]. Additionally, Microsoft adopted a new FASB standard on segment reporting in FY2025, which required enhanced disclosures including cost of revenue and operating expenses for each segment [7]. Microsoft also updated its metrics, creating a new Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growth metric and combining Windows OEM and Devices into a single metric [8].
